correctness.rationale: For every n≥2 and 0≤t<1, F={x_i≥0, t≤sum x_i≤1}. Symmetry of the unique John ellipsoid gives c=(h/n)1 and Q=pP⊥+qP∥, but the proof certifies GLOBAL John maximality by direct positive John contact measures, not a restricted symmetric search. Containment is equivalent to h/n≥sqrt(((n−1)p+q)/n), h−sqrt(nq)≥t, h+sqrt(nq)≤1. Substituting the two exact shape branches yields equality of n side facets and upper rank bound, with lower bound becoming active at t*=(n−1)/(n+1). For shallow t each of n side contacts and the upper axial contact has weight n/(n+1). Above t*, writing s=sqrt(nq)/h, side weight (n−1)/(n(1−s²)) and axial weights (1±ns)/(2(1±s)) have exactly zero mean and identity second moment, all positive except lower at boundary. Reflection of vertices gives sym(F)≤1/(n−t); z=1/(n+1−t)1 meets every reflected halfspace and is uniquely forced at equality. Maximizing convex ellipsoid norm at vertices e_i and t e_i gives John-centered radius n initially and sqrt(1+(n−1)²/t) afterward. Independently recalculated support, moment and reflected-facet identities for 170 dimension/depth pairs; only the analytic arguments cover arbitrary n and t.
